mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, we are looking at clear skies with a temperature of 84 degrees, making it a beautiful day out at Reddan Soccer Park.
We have two city updates for you. First, the Fireman's Park beach is closed for the season. Second, Public Works crews are currently on the scene at 212 Todd Street to repair a water main break.
There is plenty to do in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's.
For our weekly report, on August 17, police arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's featured flavor is Turtle Dove. The store is currently open and serving until 10 PM, so stop by and grab a scoop.
